one_liner: Klaviyo has a broad REST API with private API keys and OAuth, a sandbox-style test account, and an official remote MCP server. Only the Conversations API is gated.
auth_notes: Pages show private API keys and OAuth apps (Bearer OAuth access tokens). Marketplace listing requires partner verification. The pages do not show whether OAuth app creation itself is self-serve.
access_notes: The developer portal offers a test/sandbox account linked to a production login. The fetched pages do not state pricing or fee terms, so free access is inferred. The Conversations API is limited to approved accounts and apps. The core API is not described as gated.
blocker_notes: Only the Conversations API requires approval. The earlier draft claim that webhooks may need a waitlist is unsupported by the pages and was removed.

evidence.quote: Add the remote server at `https://mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp` to your MCP client.
Klaviyo's MCP server lets an agent work with the data in a Klaviyo account.
Learn how to create a sandbox account that is linked to your production account login.
The Conversations API is available to approved accounts and apps only.
Access is granted either at the **account level** (for customers using a private API key) or at the **OAuth app level**
subscribe to the `event:klaviyo.sent_sms` webhook topic using the [Webhooks API]
